parts.answer: The intersection of the closed disc centred at $(2,0)$ with radius $1$ and the half-plane $y\le\frac12x-\frac54$.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
B1: Show a circle centred at $(2,0)$. B1FT: Show the relevant part of a circle of radius $1$; follow through a centre not at the origin even if it is incorrectly placed at $1-2i$, and it must clearly pass through $(1,0)$ or $(3,0)$ (or the corresponding points for follow through). B1: Show the point representing $1-2i$; this may be implied by the correct perpendicular bisector. B1FT: Show the perpendicular bisector of the segment joining $1-2i$ to the origin, perpendicular by eye and through the midpoint by eye; it must reach the midpoint and, if extended, cut the stated circle boundaries. B1: Shade the correct region, dependent on all earlier marks except in the printed no-scale case. The scheme permits scale implied by dashes and lists three scale cases, with the final shading mark available in each if the construction relationships are correct.
Total: [5]
